title: Important notice
text: Important notice The shareholders (the “Shareholders”) of [x] have retained Kumulus Partners NV (“Kumulus Partners” or “Financial Adviser”) to act as their exclusive financial adviser in connection with their search for an acquirer for all of their shareholding in the Company (“the Transaction”). The Shareholders have authorised the Financial Adviser to issue this confidential information memorandum (the “Information Memorandum”) to a limited number of recipients who have expressed an interest in being considered as a candidate acquirer of the Company (the “Candidate Acquirer”) and have signed a confidentiality undertaking for this purpose (the “Confidentiality Undertaking”). The Information Memorandum has been prepared for information purposes relating to this proposed Transaction and is delivered subject to the terms, and the prior execution, of the Confidentiality Undertaking. It may be used only for the purposes set forth in the Confidentiality Undertaking and may not be photocopied, reproduced or distributed to any other person at any time except strictly in accordance with the terms of that undertaking. The Information Memorandum does not purport to be all-inclusive or to contain all the information that a Candidate Acquirer may desire in deciding whether to consider a partnership with the Company or the Shareholders. No representation or warranty, express or implied, is or will be made in relation to the accuracy or completeness of this Information Memorandum or any other written or oral information made available to any Candidate Acquirer or its advisers in connection with any further investigation of the Company and no responsibility or liability is or will be accepted in relation to it by the Shareholders, the Company, the Financial Adviser or by any of their respective employees or agents. The Shareholders, the Company, the Financial Adviser and their respective subsidiaries and associated companies and their respective officers, employees and agents expressly disclaim any and all liability which may be based on this Information Memorandum or such information, and any errors therein or omissions therefrom. In particular (without limiting the generality of the foregoing), no representation or warranty is given as to the achievement or reasonableness of future projections, management targets, prospects or returns. In providing the Information Memorandum, neither the Shareholders, the Company or the Financial Adviser undertake any obligation to provide the recipient with access to any additional information or to update this Information Memorandum or any other information provided or to correct any inaccuracies therein that may become apparent. The Information Memorandum does not constitute an offer or invitation for the sale or purchase of any securities of the Company or its subsidiaries and associated companies and does not constitute any form of commitment or recommendation on the part of the Shareholders or the Company or any of its respective subsidiaries or associated companies. The Information Memorandum is not intended to provide the basis of any credit, investment or other evaluation. Neither this Information Memorandum, nor any other written or oral information made available to any Candidate Acquirer or its advisers will form the basis of any contract. A proposal regarding the acquisition of or investment in the Company will give rise to any contractual obligations on the part of the Shareholders or the Company only when a definitive agreement has been executed. The Shareholders and the Company will accept only those obligations to a Candidate Acquirer, which may be set forth in such definitive agreement. Recipients of this Information Memorandum should obtain information on their own, and observe any applicable legal requirements in their jurisdictions. The Financial Adviser is acting for the Shareholders in connection with the envisaged Transaction and will be responsible to no-one else other than the Shareholders for providing advice in relation to the envisaged Transaction. Any Candidate Acquirer is recommended to seek its own independent financial advice and conduct their own investigation and analysis of the Company or any of its respective subsidiaries or associated companies. Any communication of, or request for, information concerning the Information Memorandum and any future information about the Company and the Transaction should be addressed exclusively to the undersigned at the Financial Adviser. Under no circumstances should the Shareholders, the directors, management or employees of the Company be contacted directly without the prior written agreement of the Financial Adviser. All inquiries and requests for additional information should be directed to the individuals below: Ruben Goeman Partner +32 472 83 32 43 ruben.goeman@kumuluspartners.com Lore Mouton Associate +32 472 83 32 43 lore.mouton@kumuluspartners.com Marco Tinck Analyst +32 487 44 02 07 marco.tinck@kumuluspartners.com Johan Verstraeten Partner +32 479 98 09 15 johan.verstraeten@kumuluspartners.com Bart Collier Partner +32 474 26 24 31 bart.collier@kumuluspartners.com Isaak Hölzken Associate +32 479 72 08 30 isaak.holzken@kumuluspartners.com Kaat Teunissen Analyst +32 498 14 55 45 kaat.teunissen@kumuluspartners.com Marco Tinck Analyst + 32 487 44 02 07 marco.tinck@kumuluspartners.com Jarne Van Tongel Analyst + 32 474 66 76 41 jarne.vantongel@kumuluspartners.com Lore Mouton Analyst +32 473 20 28 21 lore.mouton@kumuluspartners.com Yannick Michiels Associate + 32 471 86 69 55 yannick.michiels@kumuluspartners.com Henk Vivile Partner + 32 477 34 34 23 henk.vivile@kumuluspartners.com Ruben Goeman Partner +32 472 83 32 43 ruben.goeman@kumuluspartners.com IM Disclaimer
